_purpose: Durable session-handover context for the Job Bot project. Update this file when compacting chat history so a fresh session can resume without re-deriving decisions. Keep it factual and current; prune anything stale. Update 'last_updated' and append to 'changelog' on each edit.

project.name: jobbot
project.description: Discord bot that discovers software-engineering internships via a configurable search API (Serper/Bing/Brave/Google PSE), extracts + de-duplicates + relevance-filters postings across major ATS platforms, and posts them to Discord as embeds with action buttons.

deployment.target: User's Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 1 home server (Fedora Workstation, dual-boot with Windows; Docker + compose preinstalled, firewalld + SELinux stay ON). Deploy via Docker Compose + Postgres using docker-compose.prod.yml (DEPLOY.md Path A).
deployment.alternatives: Path B: systemd + SQLite bare-metal (deploy/jobbot.service) for Oracle Cloud VM / Raspberry Pi. Path C: Fly/Railway/Render/AWS. All documented in DEPLOY.md.
deployment.database: Postgres in compose for the ThinkPad deployment; SQLite remains the zero-service default for bare-metal (DATABASE_URL switch, no code changes). Only Postgres-specific feature is the cross-process scan advisory lock.
deployment.sqlite_path_note: Bare-metal SQLite needs an ABSOLUTE path, e.g. sqlite+aiosqlite:////opt/jobbot/jobbot.db (four slashes).
deployment.prod_compose_notes: docker-compose.prod.yml is STANDALONE (not an overlay): 127.0.0.1-only port binds (Docker publishing bypasses firewalld), restart: unless-stopped, POSTGRES_PASSWORD is REQUIRED via .env (no default — GitGuardian flags literal creds; also baked into pgdata on first init).
deployment.laptop_server_prep: logind HandleLidSwitch=ignore, mask sleep/suspend/hibernate targets, Linux as GRUB default — commands in DEPLOY.md Path A.
deployment.network_gotcha: Bot only makes OUTBOUND connections; no inbound ports/forwarding/firewall changes on any path. /health binds to localhost.

key_decisions: Deterministic-first: query gen, URL canonicalization, dedup, and relevance scoring are pure/tested functions. LLM classification is opt-in (ENABLE_LLM_CLASSIFICATION) and only refines an already-passing result.
Protocol-based extension points: SearchProvider and PlatformAdapter are drop-in. PlatformRegistry maps hostnames to adapters.

Bounded query generation (no Cartesian explosion): templates per (platform, title-group), decorated with term/location clauses; select_batch reserves top-priority queries and rotates a window over the rest.

Job identity via dedup_key: platform+requisition-id -> canonical URL -> normalized company+title. Re-discovery updates last_seen; job_versions snapshot only on material content change; Discord posting gated on posted_to_discord.
SQLite chosen over Postgres for single-instance simplicity; advisory lock is dialect-aware (real pg lock on Postgres, no-op on SQLite where the scheduler's asyncio lock serializes scans).
Postgres drivers (asyncpg/psycopg) moved to optional [postgres] extra so base install is ARM-friendly with no compiled deps.

current_state.tests: 215 passing (pytest); unit + integration, no network required
current_state.db_schema: 15 tables. 0001_initial uses metadata.create_all (NOT a frozen snapshot); 0002 adds the platform-priority columns and is idempotent-by-inspection to survive both fresh and existing databases.
current_state.lint: ruff clean; ruff format applied across codebase (ruff 0.15.21)
current_state.deployment_status: LIVE on the ThinkPad since 2026-08-08 (docker-compose.prod.yml). Scans run every 6h and the pipeline works; the post channel was unset until 2026-08-17, so ~684 jobs queued up unposted. Delivery is capped at 25/scan.

discovery_paths.search: SearchProvider (Serper/Bing/Brave/Google PSE) over generated site: queries — consumes API quota.
discovery_paths.listing_sources: jobbot/sources/ — curated feeds mapped straight to ExtractedJob, no page fetch, no search quota. SimplifyJobs listings.json enabled by default (ENABLE_GITHUB_LISTINGS), ETag-conditional so an unchanged 11 MB feed costs a 304. Live check 2026-08-04: 489 candidates in a 30-day window, 319 passing the 0.55 gate.
discovery_paths.shared_tail: Both paths converge on ScanService._ingest (dedup -> score -> persist), then _post_pending (expiration -> poster).
discovery_paths.publishing: jobbot/publishers/ — optional mirror of the open listing to a GitHub repo README via the Contents API (ENABLE_GITHUB_PUBLISH, off by default). Change detection uses a content-hash marker embedded in the file that excludes the timestamp, so an unchanged listing makes no commit. All cell values are escaped because feed data is published publicly.

conventions.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on push/PR to master: ruff check, ruff format --check, pytest, and a SQLite alembic upgrade head smoke test.
conventions.pre_commit: .pre-commit-config.yaml (ruff lint+format + hygiene hooks). Enable with 'make hooks' after 'make install'. Pinned: ruff v0.15.21, pre-commit-hooks v6.0.0.
conventions.workflow: Work on a branch, open a PR, wait for CI green, squash-merge, delete branch. Never commit directly to master.
conventions.secrets: Never commit .env. Config is validated by Pydantic (src/jobbot/config.py) and fails fast.

quick_reference.keyless_dry_run: set SEARCH_PROVIDERS=mock in .env to exercise the pipeline with no API key

architecture_pointers.parsing: src/jobbot/parsing/ (url canon, ssrf guard, jsonld, fetcher, extractor)

feature_flags_and_roadmap.enabled_now: search -> extract -> dedup -> filter -> relevance -> expiration -> Discord embeds + buttons; all slash commands; per-guild scheduling.
off_by_default: Playwright rendering for JS-only job pages (install [playwright] extra) - relevant for Workday/Oracle/SuccessFactors which are often JS-rendered
scaffolded_not_wired: Digests (hourly/daily/weekly) and per-category subscription roles - schema (subscriptions, job_categories) and digest embed builder exist; scheduling them is the next increment

open_items: User's guild still needs `/jobs set-locations locations:"Bay Area, Toronto, Seattle, NYC, Redmond" required:True` after deploying #11 — the filter is opt-in per guild and their existing row has require_location=false.

Deploy to the ThinkPad home server via DEPLOY.md Path A (Docker Compose) — this is the first REAL run; watch how extraction/scoring behave on live ATS pages. Consider GITHUB_LISTINGS_LOOKBACK_DAYS=3 for the first scan so the feed backlog does not trickle out 25/scan.
Optional: enable GitHub branch protection on master requiring the 'test' status check (must be toggled in GitHub Settings > Branches; cannot be set via CLI here).

KNOWN BUGS still open (all verified, none fixed yet): (1) normalize_title truncates at the first ' - ', so distinct roles at one company collapse to one dedup key and only one is ever posted (e.g. Notion 'SWE Intern - Summer 2027' vs '- Winter 2027'); (2) /jobs pause writes the flag but nothing reads it at scan time; (3) no on_guild_join handler, so a server joined after startup gets no scheduled scans until restart; (4) importing jobbot.platforms.* before jobbot.parsing.* raises ImportError (circular import); (5) APScheduler jobs have no misfire_grace_time, so a run whose fire time passes while the host is suspended is skipped entirely.

Scorer precision: 'Business Systems Analyst Intern', 'Front-End AI Marketing Co-op' etc. score 0.9+ because systems/AI/data/front-end count as software indicators. Needs a role-noun requirement (engineer/developer/programmer), not just a software-adjacent token. Mitigable now via /jobs set-negative-keywords (which works as of PR #8).
Consider Playwright path for Workday/Oracle/SuccessFactors postings if JSON-LD extraction returns empty over plain HTTP.
Consider a live-API integration test (skipped unless a key env var is set) to catch ATS HTML changes.
changelog: 2026-08-18 PR #11: location filtering. scoring/locations.py adds alias groups (bay area/toronto/seattle/nyc/redmond, remote opt-in) and match_location(); ScoringPrefs.require_location turns `locations` from a bonus into a hard filter applied at INGEST so filtered jobs never enter the DB. Bare state codes are intentionally excluded as aliases so 'Ontario, CA' and 'Spokane, WA' are rejected. DEFAULT_LOCATIONS in queries/terms.py narrowed to the five target metros so query generation matches. Migration 0003 (require_location), idempotent like 0002. Live effect: 465 -> 252 relevant candidates over 30 days (bay 169, seattle 32, toronto 29, nyc 22).

2026-08-17 PR #10: GitHub README publishing (jobbot/publishers/). Renders open jobs as a Markdown table and commits via the GitHub Contents API after each scan; off unless ENABLE_GITHUB_PUBLISH + token + repo are set. Tests caught three holes in the first implementation: repo slug '../evil' passed validation (path traversal into the API path), '/abs/path' passed path validation, and backslash-escaping '<' was weaker than entity-encoding — all fixed in source.

2026-08-17 PR #9: platform priority. Scorer now grades the hosting ATS (new platform_pref weight 0.10) instead of giving every ATS a flat bonus: ashby/greenhouse/lever/workable/smartrecruiters full, other known ATS half, workday/oracle/successfactors/icims/adp none. Configurable per guild via /jobs set-platform-priority (new guild_settings columns + migration 0002). NOTE 0002 is idempotent-by-inspection because 0001_initial uses metadata.create_all and therefore already creates new columns on a FRESH db while an existing db lacks them — every future additive migration needs the same treatment until 0001 is frozen to an explicit schema.
2026-07-14 Initial handover.json created after PRs #1-#3 (SQLite/no-Docker, CI, pre-commit).

2026-08-17 PR #8: fixed guild settings never reaching the scorer. ScanService called score_job(preferred_locations=None, preferred_terms=None) and never passed negative_keywords/extra_keywords at all, so /jobs set-locations, set-terms, set-negative-keywords and set-keywords had ZERO effect on ranking and no job could score above 0.82 (= 1.00 - 0.10 term - 0.08 location; confirmed in production where max_score was exactly 0.82). Introduced ScoringPrefs bundling all four settings so a caller cannot thread the threshold while dropping the rest; added extra_software_keywords to widen the software gate via /jobs set-keywords. Regression tests at BOTH layers (unit + integration) — the integration ones verified to fail without the fix.

2026-08-04 PR #6: added jobbot/sources/ + SimplifyJobs listings source (ETag-conditional, category/lookback filters, http(s)-only URL guard). Refactored ScanService: extracted shared _ingest() used by both search and feeds; Poster contract now returns {job_id: message_id} of ACTUALLY delivered jobs so the service owns posted-state. Fixed 2 pre-existing bugs the new integration test caught: (1) _touch_existing walked the lazy job.sources relationship -> MissingGreenlet on every duplicate re-discovery; (2) failed Discord sends were marked posted and never retried. Also generalized term parsing (parse_internship_term) which was hardcoded to 2027 and silently dropped 2026/2028 terms.

2026-08-02 PR #5: DEPLOY.md (3 deployment paths + troubleshooting), standalone docker-compose.prod.yml, POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env.example, README deployment section slimmed to a pointer.
